name: Backup age exceeded
query: sacco_backup_age_seconds > 129600 (36h expressed in seconds) — latest gauge reading.
window: n/a — point-in-time gauge check evaluated on each business-gauge beat run
notes: Emitted by record_business_gauges (app/core/observability/metrics.py) from platform.backup_runs, written exclusively by the pgBackRest sidecar (Phase 4 — see Ops module contracts in CLAUDE.md). When no succeeded backup run exists yet, the gauge reports NO_BACKUP_AGE_SENTINEL (~1 year), which reliably trips this alert instead of reading as healthy at 0.
